topic: How do distributed satellite constellations impact orbital configuration trade-offs between coverage and inter-satellite interference mitigation?
consensus_response: Distributed satellite constellations impact orbital configuration by trading off coverage and inter-satellite interference mitigation. Optimizing Walker delta patterns, using directional antennas, and employing TDMA/CDMA protocols mitigate interference. Beamforming and adaptive modulation/coding further reduce interference, enhancing link budgets and spectral efficiency.
reference_context: SatCom systems face trade-offs between coverage and interference, with techniques like LDMA, TDMA, and CDMA mitigating interference.
